The following items are required for application acceptance. Documents submitted with your building
department application MUST coincide with the documents submitted with your land use board
application. Documents submitted with your building department application cannot be used for this
application and must be submitted separately. Any changes to the originally submitted documents must
be reviewed by the building department before scheduling a land use board hearing.
1. This application completed, signed, and dated.
2. A narrative summary explaining the project. Include all relevant information that would be of
interest to the board.
3. A copy of the referral letter from the building department, which is the document that referred
you to this board. Or a copy of your decision if your project was previously reviewed by the
Planning Board or Zoning Board of Appeals.
4. Copy of the recorded deed to present owner of the property. If you are a tenant of the property,
the lease is needed as well. If you need a copy of your deed, this can be purchased through the
Rockland County Land Records at the Rockland County Clerk·s Office (845-638-5070).
5. Agents must provide written authorization from the owner to appear in front of the board if the
owner will not appear with them, this is not included with this application. Contract Purchaser
may file a copy of the contract.
6. If the owner and/or applicant is listed as an Entity, a completed Entity Disclosure Statement
MUST be submitted with this application. If the owner and the tenant are different, then an
Entity Disclosure is required for each party. Please note, the only accepted Entity Disclosure
Statement is the Town of Orangetown·s Entity Disclosure Statement.
7. If you are coming before the Historic Areas Board of Review for a sign application, please
complete the Sign Questionnaire on page 3 of this application and you can skip step 8, below.
8. Completed ·Exterior Alteration Checklist· on pages 4-6 of this application.
9. Self-sealing, #10 envelopes, with a USPS forever stamp attached and addressed to all property
owners within 200· of the perimeter of the site. The return address should be left blank.
Applicants must request the property mailing list from the Board Clerk and submit a copy of
this list with their application.
